samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
	<description>A simple Radix-2 Divider for 8-bit operands, supporting both signed and unsigned division.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
		<input id="rst">Reset signal for initialization or resetting the module.</input>
		<input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
		<input id="dividend">The 8-bit dividend for division.</input>
		<input id="divisor">The 8-bit divisor for division.</input>
		<input id="opn_valid">Valid operation request indicator.</input>
		
		<output id="res_valid">Result validity indicator.</output>
		<output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit result containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
	endports
	
	<parameter_description>
		<!-- Named constants for FSM states or other parameters can be defined here -->
	</parameter_description>
	
	<logic_description type="combinational_logic">
		reg [7:0] dividend_reg;
		reg [7:0] divisor_reg;
		wire [7:0] abs_dividend = sign ? (~dividend + 1'b1) : dividend;
		wire [7:0] abs_divisor = sign ? (~divisor + 1'b1) : divisor;
		reg [15:0] SR;
		reg [3:0] cnt;
		reg [3:0] start_cnt;
		reg [7:0] NEG_DIVISOR;
		reg [15:0] temp;
		wire [8:0] sub_result = {1'b0,SR[15:8]} - {1'b0,NEG_DIVISOR};
		wire carry_out = ~sub_result[8];
		wire [15:0] mux_out = carry_out ? ({1'b0,sub_result[7:0],SR[7:0]} << 1) | (carry_out << 8) :
													({1'b0,SR[15:8],SR[7:0]} << 1);
	endlogic
	
	<implementation>
		res_valid <= !rst && (!cnt || res_valid);
		result <= res_valid ? SR : 'bz;
		always @(posedge clk) begin
			if(!rst) begin
				cnt <= 'd0;
				start_cnt <= 'd0;
				SR <= 'd0;
				temp <= 'd0;
			end else if(opn_valid & !res_valid) begin
				dividend_reg <= abs_dividend;
				divisor_reg <= abs_divisor;
				SR <= {abs_dividend,1'b0}; // Shift dividend left by 1 bit
				NEG_DIVISOR <= ~(abs_divisor) + 1'b1; // Negate the divisor for subtraction
				cnt <= 1'd1;
				start_cnt <= 1'd1;
			end else if(start_cnt) begin
				if(cnt[3]) begin
					cnt <= 'd0;
					start_cnt <= 'd0;
					SR <= mux_out;
				end else begin
					cnt <= cnt + 1'd1;
					SR</implementation></logic_description></ports></module>
